Description: Product page loads with title and price.
Buyer can view the product image gallery.
Price and SKU are visible on the product page.
Buyer can select a product variant such as size or color.
Buyer can change quantity on the product page.
System blocks quantity greater than available stock.
Buyer adds the product to cart from the detail page.
Buy Now starts checkout or asks the guest to sign in.
Logged-in buyer can add the product to wishlist.
Guest is prompted to log in when using wishlist.
Seller name and Sold by details display on the product page.
Buyer can check a shipping estimate, typically by ZIP code.
Return policy is linked or shown on the product page.
Product reviews section is available on the product page.
Logged-in buyer can submit a product question.
Related products are shown on the product page.
Specification details are available on the product page.
Rich A+ brand content displays on the product page.
Inactive product URLs do not show a buyable product page.
Deleted product URLs show a not-found page.
